Congress Criticizes Jewar Airport Renaming, Cites Nehru's Example

The Congress party has criticized the renaming of Jewar Airport after Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Party leader Jairam Ramesh questioned the decision, drawing a parallel to former Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru's refusal to have institutions named after him in 1949. Ramesh highlighted Nehru's example of declining proposals to name facilities after himself. The coverage also notes that the Jewar Airport has not had a single international flight in eight months.
